user.title: Varmemodel
user.description: Pick your own meters and sensors. Only electricity, outdoor and room temperatures are required – the more you add, the more can be calibrated.

data.name: Name
data.window_days: Days of data used for calibration

data_description.heat_energy: Without it COP, heat loss and emission cannot be calibrated.
data_description.indoor_temps: The average is used as the indoor temperature.
data_description.compressor: Used to find full running hours and count starts.
data_description.defrost: Defrosts are counted per power and outdoor temperature.
data_description.dhw: Hours with hot water are excluded from space heating.
data_description.flow_setpoint: E.g. the water setpoint. Used to fit the heating curve.
data_description.curve_offset: E.g. the entity whose target shifts the curve.
data_description.curve_offset_zero: E.g. 17 if a target of 17 means curve 0.

error.no_statistics: Entity has no long-term statistics (missing state_class).
